items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: I don't remember no William Bailey. What was his first name? Ed Bailey.

ctx.x: Was that William Bailey? No, that was his brother, I think, who was the physician.
I don't remember no William Bailey. What was his first name? Ed Bailey.
Ed Bailey; right. I remember the name William Bailey because his brother was our family doctor.
